comments.text:
You're standing in Warsaw's Old Town, surrounded by walls that look 300 years old. Then someone tells you not a single brick here is older than 80. 🧱
That's only the opening of this Poland documentary. Later, we follow how a nation erased from the map for 123 years became richer than Spain — and what that is doing to the price of a home.
👉 If you moved to Poland tomorrow, would you pick historic Kraków or seaside Gdańsk? Tell us below 👇 and subscribe so you don't miss the next journey.
